fields.what_it_is: CD HORIZON® SOLERA® Spinal System. A spinal system that facilitates surgeon choice and flexibility across patient types with a variety of implant options for treating multiple spinal pathologies with one system family. Implant options include Multi-Axial Screw (MAS), ATS™ 4.75mm AWL-TAP Multi-Axial Screw, Sagittal Adjusting Screw (SAS), Fixed Angle Screw (FAS), Multi-Axial Reduction Screw (MARS), Hydroxyapatite (HA) Coated Multi-Axial Screw, Break-off Set Screw, Rod Spectrum (CHROMALOY™, CHROMALOY™ Plus, Commercially Pure Titanium, Titanium Alloy, CHROMALOY™ Plus Apex Rods, CHROMALOY™ Plus Tapered Rods), CD HORIZON® X10 CROSSLINK® Plate, Hooks, Closed Multi-Axial Screws (CMAS), and Lateral Connectors. Materials include commercially pure titanium, titanium alloy, CHROMALOY™, CHROMALOY™ Plus, cobalt chrome, and hydroxyapatite coating.

fields.compatible_with: Compatible with CD HORIZON® SOLERA® SEXTANT® and CD HORIZON® LONGITUDE® II 4.75mm Extenders (for ATS™ 4.75mm AWL-TAP Multi-Axial Screw). Compatible with CHROMALOY™, CHROMALOY™ Plus, and Titanium Rods (for Multi-Axial Screw, Fixed Angle Screw, CD HORIZON® X10 CROSSLINK® Plate, Hooks, Lateral Connectors). Compatible with 5.5mm and 6.0mm rod diameters (for Sagittal Adjusting Screw). Compatible with 4.75mm, 5.5mm, and 6.35mm rod diameter systems (for CD HORIZON® X10 CROSSLINK® Plate). Compatible with the 6.0mm Lateral Connector Post (for Closed Multi-Axial Screws). Compatible with set screws 7049855, 779170005, 5440030 (4.75mm), 5540030 (5.5/6.0mm). Compatible with triggered intraoperative EMG monitoring, such as the NIM-ECLIPSE® Spinal System. Compatible with the O-ARM® Imaging System coupled with the STEALTHSTATION® Image Guidance System. Compatible with the POWEREASE® System. Interbody or vertebral body replacement options include T2 ALTITUDE™ Expandable Corpectomy System, CAPSTONE® PEEK Spinal System, CRESCENT® Spinal System—PEEK, CRESCENT® Spinal System—Titanium, CLYDESDALE® Spinal System, and SOVEREIGN® Spinal System.
fields.use_notes: From the thoracic spine to the ilium. The system offers the opportunity to reduce overall metal mass and profile. The technology platform offered with this system is backed by more than 25 years of CD HORIZON® clinical experience and Medtronic expertise. Low Profile Implants, Rod Material Choices, Power, Neuromonitoring, and Navigation Compatibility, Minimally Invasive Approach Options, Advanced Instrumentation, Implant Traceability. Surgical technique includes steps for Pedicle Screw Surgical Technique (Thoracic Facetectomy and Starting Points, Screw Starting Points, Screw Options, Pedicle Preparation, Enabling Technologies, VERIFYI® Implant Tracking System, Screw Placement, ATS™ AWL TAP Multi-Axial Screw Implant Placement Technique), Lateral Connectors, Interbody or Vertebral Body Replacement Options, Rod Selection, Rod Contouring and Placement, Provisional Driver Assembly, Rod Reduction (Forceps Rocker Method, 4.75mm European Rocker Method, Beale Rod Reducer), Sequential Rod Reduction, 5.5/6.0mm Lateral Translator, 5.5/6.0mm SMARTLINK™ Extenders, SMARTLINK™ Derotators, Deformity Correction, Compression and Distraction, Final Tightening and Decortication, Bone Graft Options, CD HORIZON® X10 CROSSLINK® Plate Placement, Final Tightening of the Plate, Postoperative Care and Mobilization, Hook Surgical Technique (Hook Site Preparation, Options, and Insertion), and CD HORIZON® X10 CROSSLINK® Plate Placement and Closure. Detailed instrument overview and set lists are provided. Risks associated with these spinal implants include loosening, disassembly, bending and/or breakage of components. The CD HORIZON® Spinal System has not been evaluated for safety, heating, migration or compatibility in the magnetic resonance environment. Improper positioning and placement of implants may cause damage.
